name: knowledge-diff-core
description: Balanced, hand-labeled code/documentation changes covering architecture, configuration, API, security, and harmless refactors.

sharedDocs.content:
# Engineering Guide

## Monitoring
Application logs are emitted by `src/monitoring/logger.ts`. Monitoring changes should preserve structured JSON output.

## Testing
Unit tests live beside the code they cover and should remain deterministic.

## Deployment
Production services run in containers and expose health checks.

# Changelog

## Unreleased
Routine maintenance, dependency updates, and test improvements.

cases.description: State management changes from Redux Toolkit to Zustand while architecture docs still require Redux.

docs.content:
# Architecture

## State Management
All global state uses Redux Toolkit. The cart is implemented as `src/store/cart.ts` with `createSlice`; Zustand is not used.

cases.description: A documented endpoint moves from API v1 to v2.

docs.content:
# API

## Users
Clients must call `/api/v1/users`, implemented in `src/routes/users.ts`. Version 1 is the only supported users endpoint.

cases.description: Primary persistence changes from PostgreSQL to MongoDB.

docs.content:
# Database

## User storage
User records in `src/db/users.ts` are stored exclusively in PostgreSQL through the `pg` Pool. MongoDB is not part of the system.

cases.description: Cache lifetime falls from one hour to five minutes despite an exact documented guarantee.

docs.content:
# Caching

## Expiration
`CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` in `src/cache/config.ts` is fixed at `3600`, so cached entries remain valid for one hour.

cases.description: Authentication changes from bearer JWTs to server-side sessions.

docs.content:
# Authentication

## Request authentication
`src/auth/middleware.ts` authenticates every request using a bearer JWT from the authorization header. Cookie sessions are never used.

cases.description: The default OpenAI model changes but the configuration table keeps the old default.

docs.content:
# Configuration

## Models
`OPENAI_MODEL` in `src/models.ts` defaults to `gpt-4o`. Users get that model unless they override it.

cases.description: The service port changes from 3000 to 8080 while deployment docs prescribe 3000.

docs.content:
# Deployment

## Networking
`API_PORT` in `src/server.ts` is `3000`; containers and load balancers must route traffic to port 3000.

cases.description: Object storage moves from Amazon S3 to Google Cloud Storage.

docs.content:
# Uploads

## Storage
`src/storage/uploads.ts` stores every uploaded object in Amazon S3 using `S3Client`. Google Cloud Storage is unsupported.

cases.description: Event transport changes from RabbitMQ to Kafka.

docs.content:
# Events

## Message bus
`src/events/bus.ts` publishes all domain events through RabbitMQ. Kafka is deliberately excluded to keep operations simple.

cases.description: Report generation changes from synchronous completion to queued asynchronous work.

docs.content:
# Reports

## Generation
`generateReport` in `src/reports/generate.ts` builds and returns the finished PDF synchronously within the request. It never enqueues background work.

cases.description: Payload encryption changes away from the exact documented cipher.

docs.content:
# Security

## Payload encryption
`CIPHER` in `src/crypto/payload.ts` is always `aes-256-gcm`. Interoperating clients must use AES-256-GCM.

cases.description: The public request limit is reduced while docs guarantee the former value.

docs.content:
# Rate limits

## Public API
`REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE` in `src/http/rate-limit.ts` permits exactly `100` requests per client each minute.

cases.description: A read-only replica begins receiving writes contrary to the architecture guarantee.

docs.content:
# Database

## Read replica
`src/db/replica.ts` performs reads only. No UPDATE, INSERT, or DELETE query is ever sent to the replica.

cases.description: Webhook HMAC changes from SHA-256 to SHA-512.

docs.content:
# Webhooks

## Signature verification
`src/webhooks/verify.ts` signs payloads with `sha256`. Consumers must calculate an HMAC-SHA256 digest.

cases.description: A feature becomes enabled by default despite documentation saying it is opt-in.

docs.content:
# Features

## Semantic search
`SEMANTIC_SEARCH_ENABLED` in `src/features/search.ts` defaults to `false`. Semantic search is strictly opt-in.

cases.description: Structured request logging is added without contradicting the API architecture.

docs.content:
# HTTP service

## Middleware
`src/http/app.ts` uses Express middleware. Additional middleware such as `requestLogger` may be installed for operational needs.

cases.description: An internal function is renamed while its documented behavior stays identical.

docs.content:
# Cart

## Totals
`src/cart/total.ts` sums item prices and applies discounts before returning the cart total. The internal helper name is not part of the public API.

cases.description: An optional cache is added where documentation explicitly permits caching.

docs.content:
# Catalog

## Product reads
`listProducts` in `src/catalog/products.ts` returns product records from the primary database. Implementations may use Redis as a transparent read cache.

cases.description: Only an error message changes; the documented status and endpoint remain stable.

docs.content:
# API

## User lookup
`src/routes/users.ts` returns HTTP `404` when a user cannot be found. Error-message wording is not a stable contract.

cases.description: A configurable override is added while retaining the documented default timeout.

docs.content:
# Configuration

## Timeouts
`REQUEST_TIMEOUT` in `src/config/timeout.ts` defaults to `30` seconds and can be overridden through deployment configuration.

cases.description: A new edge-case test does not change the documented tax calculation.

docs.content:
# Tax

## Calculation
`calculateTax` is covered by unit tests in `src/tax/calculate.test.ts`. Tax rules themselves are implemented in the production module.

cases.description: A theme token changes where documentation promises customization, not a specific color.

docs.content:
# Theming

## Colors
`primaryColor` in `src/theme/colors.ts` is a customizable design token. Applications may select any accessible brand color.

cases.description: A new endpoint is added to non-exhaustive API documentation.

docs.content:
# API

## Overview
Routes in `src/routes/health.ts` use the `/api/v1/` prefix. Examples include `/api/v1/users`; the list is not exhaustive and new endpoints may be added.

cases.description: A dependency patch update retains the same documented framework.

docs.content:
# Architecture

## Web framework
The service uses Express, declared in `package.json`. Compatible maintenance releases may be adopted without changing the architecture.

cases.description: A defensive null check enforces rather than contradicts the documented behavior.

docs.content:
# Accounts

## Lookup
`findAccount` in `src/accounts/find.ts` returns `null` when no account identifier is supplied or no record exists.

cases.description: A local PostgreSQL variable is renamed without changing storage behavior.

docs.content:
# Database

## Connection
`src/db/connection.ts` connects to PostgreSQL with the `pg` Pool and exports a shared pool. Internal variable names are not contractual.

cases.description: An opt-in telemetry path is added while preserving the documented disabled default.

docs.content:
# Privacy

## Telemetry
`telemetryEnabled` in `src/telemetry/config.ts` is `false` by default. A user may explicitly opt in through configuration.

cases.description: A timeout value changes where docs intentionally make no numeric guarantee.

docs.content:
# Jobs

## Timeouts
`JOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` in `src/jobs/timeout.ts` is tuned as operational needs change. No fixed timeout duration is part of the public contract.

cases.description: PayPal support is added alongside Stripe; docs never claim Stripe is exclusive.

docs.content:
# Payments

## Providers
`src/payments/providers.ts` supports Stripe. The provider registry is extensible and may include PayPal or other processors.

cases.description: An internal module path changes while the documented public import remains stable.

docs.content:
# SDK

## Public API
Consumers import `createClient` from the package root exposed by `src/index.ts`. Files under `internal` or `core` are implementation details.
